sources.text: Reviewer-added person: Morgan Reyes (Partner IT); the meeting’s “Morgan” refers to this person. Not yet verified. Resolved by: Aaron Damiano, 2026-10-13 11:01. Meeting basis: Weekly board walk, 2026-10-01, S013: “Morgan, James said the partner side may have more observers for the upcoming transfer. Is there a visitor list or a process for managing those names?”. Resolution note: Morgan Reyes runs the partner network per the attendee list.

Reviewer-confirmed assignment: Sofia Alvarez owns AI-403 “Verify staging-area load suitability for heavy equipment and file cases, identify an alternate staging area if needed, and confirm the appropriate location”. Resolved by: Aaron Damiano, 2026-10-13 11:01. Meeting basis: Weekly board walk, 2026-10-01, S039: “One other logistics concern. The picture of the staging area looks like it may have temporary flooring or lightweight panels. Please make sure the Partner agency knows the equipment and file cases are heavy. We do not want to put them somewhere that cannot support the load.”. Resolution note: Sofia confirmed by email on Oct 2 she owns the staging check.

Reviewer-set task date: AI-203 “Run a test transfer with a sample file” is due 2027-05-22. Resolved by: Aaron Damiano, 2026-10-13 11:01. Meeting basis: Weekly board walk, 2026-10-01, S014: “There seems to be some conflict in the dates that we are trying to clean up. The transfer period that had been discussed as May eighteenth through May twenty-eighth is now being described as May eighteenth through May twenty-second. The current expectation may be that people work”. Resolution note: Partner confirmed May 22, 2027 by email.
